items.name: data-grid
items.title: Data Grid
items.description: An editable data grid: range selection, spreadsheet clipboard, editing engine, validation, sorting, filtering, pinning, streaming updates. Real DOM cells, shadcn styling.
items.author: gridcn
items.docs: Docs & quick start: https://gridcn.vercel.app/docs/learning-path/render-your-first-grid Optional: wrap your app in TooltipProvider (components/ui/tooltip) so grid tooltips open at once. See https://gridcn.vercel.app/docs/terms-help/fix-install-problems#tooltips

items.name: data-grid-presence
items.title: Data Grid Presence
items.description: Multiplayer presence add-on for the gridcn data grid: useDataGridPresence registers an overlay plugin that paints remote users' live selections as named, colored highlights, with zero core re-renders.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-fill
items.title: Data Grid Fill
items.description: Fill-handle add-on for the gridcn data grid: drag-to-tile with series inference (arithmetic runs, zero-padded numbers, prefix+number sequences), mod+D/mod+R keyboard fill, via the overlay-plugin seam, with zero core re-renders.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-pinned-rows
items.title: Data Grid Pinned Rows
items.description: Pinned top/bottom row bands add-on for the gridcn data grid: useDataGridPinnedRows registers a rowBands spec (e.g. a totals row) that stays sticky under the header or at the viewport's bottom edge, pixel-aligned with data rows and pinned columns. useDataGridAggregate computes filter-aware sum/avg/min/max/count for those bands, and useDataGridServerAggregate shows values a server computes for the whole result.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-lookup
items.title: Data Grid Lookup
items.description: Async lookup cell type for the gridcn data grid: remote options with search as you type, a value and label stored together, abortable requests, and bounded untrusted answers.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-history
items.title: Data Grid History
items.description: Undo/redo add-on for the gridcn data grid: op-based, id-keyed history plus a useDataGridState quick-start wrapper.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-toolbar
items.title: Data Grid Toolbar
items.description: Toolbar add-on for the gridcn data grid: quick-search with match navigation, a per-column filter menu (aligned rows, join column, drag-to-reorder via @dnd-kit/react), a header set filter (searchable distinct-values list with counts), and a column visibility/pin menu.
items.author: gridcn
items.docs: Optional: wrap your app in TooltipProvider (components/ui/tooltip) so grid tooltips open at once. See https://gridcn.vercel.app/docs/terms-help/fix-install-problems#tooltips

items.name: data-grid-context-menu
items.title: Data Grid Context Menu
items.description: Right-click context menus for the gridcn data grid: cut/copy/paste/clear/row operations on cells, sort/pin/hide/autosize on headers.
items.author: gridcn
items.docs: Optional: wrap your app in TooltipProvider (components/ui/tooltip) so grid tooltips open at once. See https://gridcn.vercel.app/docs/terms-help/fix-install-problems#tooltips

items.name: data-grid-keybindings
items.title: Data Grid Keybindings
items.description: Keyboard shortcuts dialog for the gridcn data grid, generated at runtime from the grid's effective keymap, grouped by category with platform-aware key chips; opens via '?' or a trigger.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-url-state
items.title: Data Grid URL State
items.description: Syncs the gridcn data grid's sort/filter/search, pagination and column layout state with the URL via nuqs (router-agnostic — requires a NuqsAdapter above it). Mount <DataGridUrlState prefix?> inside the provider; the prefix option namespaces the URL keys for multiple grids on one page.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: dropzone
items.title: Dropzone
items.description: Dependency-free file dropzone: drag and drop or click to choose, with accept, size, and count checks and a compact variant. Used by the data-grid-io import dialog.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-io
items.title: Data Grid IO
items.description: Import/export add-on for the gridcn data grid: xlsx and csv, with delimiter detection and preview. New user-facing strings live under `labels.io` (see lib/labels.ts DataGridIOLabels) — export button/menu, import dialog (file picker, header-row toggle, delimiter select, column mapping, preview, errors).
items.author: gridcn

items.name: use-debounce
items.title: Use Debounce
items.description: Grid-free debounce hooks: useDebounce(value, delayMs) returns the debounced value, and useDebouncedInput(value, onCommit, options) drives a text input that shows each keystroke at once and commits when typing pauses, on blur, on Enter, and on unmount, waits for an IME composition, and never lets a late echo overwrite the text being typed.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: is-composing-key
items.title: Is Composing Key
items.description: isComposingKey(event): true while a keydown belongs to an IME composition, including the Safari confirming key (keyCode 229) that reports isComposing false. Gate Enter and Escape handlers with it.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-server
items.title: Data Grid Server
items.description: One server data source for the gridcn data grid: useDataGridServerRows owns sort, filter, search, page and page size, fetches one page per state with a race guard (pages mode) or fixed-size blocks as the rendered rows move, random access over a counted result or a sequential cursor chain (scroll mode), goes back to page 1 on a spec change, keeps the last good rows on screen, and validates every answer, and exposes status, error, retry and refresh. Controlled spec, page and page size pairs take a URL pagination result. Returns gridProps for DataGrid and pager controls for the pagination bar.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-pagination
items.title: Data Grid Pagination
items.description: Pagination add-on for the gridcn data grid: useDataGridPagination (client mode slices data; server mode is fully controlled) plus a composable <DataGridPaginationBar /> footer (range, page-size select, first/prev/pages/next/last parts) — shadcn-Pagination style, renders a default layout with no children or a custom composition of parts. New user-facing strings live under labels.pagination (see data-grid/labels.ts DataGridPaginationLabels). Zero core changes — purely additive.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-sort-list
items.title: Data Grid Sort List
items.description: Toolbar sort add-on for the gridcn data grid: a sort button + popover listing applied sorts as editable, aligned rows (column / direction / remove / drag handle), with add/clear-all and precedence reordering via @dnd-kit/react drag or ArrowUp/ArrowDown on the grip (array order in SortSpec[]). New user-facing strings live under labels.sort (see data-grid/labels.ts DataGridSortLabels). Zero core changes — purely additive.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-views
items.title: Data Grid Views
items.description: Saved views add-on for the gridcn data grid: <DataGridViews /> saves, applies, updates, renames, deletes, and defaults named views of sort, filters, search, and column layout, and imports or exports one as bounded JSON checked against the live columns. useDataGridViews is the headless hook; a storage adapter (localStorage with an in-memory fallback by default, any async store) keeps the views. Zero core changes — purely additive.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-views-demo
items.title: Data Grid Views Demo
items.description: Saved views: pick, save, update, rename, delete, default, and import or export a view of sort, filters, search, and column layout.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-status-bar
items.title: Data Grid Status Bar
items.description: Status-bar add-on for the gridcn data grid: <DataGridStatusBar /> shows count, sum, avg, min, and max of the selected cells under the grid (useDataGridSelectionStats is the headless hook). Numbers are detected by value (finite numbers), sums use Neumaier-compensated summation, a single-column selection formats through that column's toDisplayText, and above 200,000 cells the walk caps and flags the values with ≈. New user-facing strings live under labels.statusBar (see data-grid/labels.ts DataGridStatusBarLabels). Zero core changes — purely additive.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-find-replace
items.title: Data Grid Find and Replace
items.description: Find-and-replace add-on for the gridcn data grid: useDataGridFindReplace returns a plugin that adds a panel (Mod+F finds, Ctrl+H replaces) sharing the quick search, with match case and whole cell options. Replace and Replace all write through each column's text codec and validation as one undoable change; planReplace is the pure planner behind them. Strings live under labels.findReplace.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-minimal-demo
items.title: Data Grid Minimal Demo
items.description: The quick-start minimum: the core item alone, `defaultData`, zero app-side state.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-streaming-demo
items.title: Data Grid Streaming Demo
items.description: A live ticker: `updateCells` streams values in place. An auto-sort switch toggles between defer (rows hold position, re-sort on demand) and immediate (correct order every tick).
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-stream-rate-demo
items.title: Data Grid Stream Rate Demo
items.description: A 100,000-row feed with pause, rate, reorder, and flash controls and live frame counters. The feed buffers its patches and makes one `updateCells` call per animation frame.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-demo
items.title: Data Grid Demo
items.description: The hero demo: an editable grid with every built-in cell type, range selection, the free data-grid-fill add-on, and native clipboard, via defaultData with zero state wiring.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-cell-types-demo
items.title: Data Grid Cell Types Demo
items.description: Every built-in cell type in one grid, plus a read-only column, a validate rule, and a custom renderCell override.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-date-picker-demo
items.title: Data Grid Date Picker Demo
items.description: A date column that opens its calendar at edit start next to one with a typed input and a calendar button.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-custom-cell-demo
items.title: Data Grid Custom Cell Demo
items.description: A worked custom cell type: currency storage as a plain number, cached locale-formatted display, and a symbol-stripping fromText, registered via the cellTypes prop.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-sorting-filtering-demo
items.title: Data Grid Sorting & Filtering Demo
items.description: Toolbar quick-search with match navigation, a per-column filter menu, and click-to-sort headers with multi-column sort.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-filter-operators-demo
items.title: Data Grid Filter Operators Demo
items.description: Per-column filter operator overrides via ColumnDef.filter.operators, plus a full column list (including hidden columns) in the sort popover via allColumns.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-history-demo
items.title: Data Grid History Demo
items.description: Undo/redo via the useDataGridState quick start, with toolbar buttons wired to the returned history object.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-context-menu-demo
items.title: Data Grid Context Menu Demo
items.description: Right-click cell menu (cut/copy/paste/clear, row operations) and header menu (sort/pin/hide/autosize) via the header dropdown.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-context-menu-slots-demo
items.title: Data Grid Context Menu Slots Demo
items.description: Custom context menu items via getCellMenuItems and getHeaderMenuItems, replacing the built-in item sets.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-keybindings-demo
items.title: Data Grid Keybindings Demo
items.description: A shortcuts dialog generated at runtime from the grid's effective keymap, opened via a toolbar button or the '?' shortcut.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-io-demo
items.title: Data Grid IO Demo
items.description: Import/export toolbar buttons: export downloads the current view as xlsx or csv; import parses a file and replaces the grid's data through onDataChange.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-print-demo
items.title: Data Grid Print Demo
items.description: Print button with a page size picker for the PDF: the chosen A4, A3, Letter, or Legal size is passed to printGrid as options.pageSize.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-export-all-demo
items.title: Data Grid Export All Demo
items.description: A paged server grid whose export menu exports the whole filtered result through an async source in batches, and whose import sends the rows to the server and refreshes.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-io-hooks-demo
items.title: Data Grid IO Hooks Demo
items.description: Every export, import, and replace hook in one small grid with a side panel: upload instead of download, typed cells, a sample file with title rows, cell and row hooks, and a replace plan you approve before it is written.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-url-state-demo
items.title: Data Grid URL State Demo
items.description: Sort/filter/search/pagination state synced to the URL via nuqs; wrapped in the Next.js app-router NuqsAdapter (swap for your framework's adapter).
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-row-markers-demo
items.title: Data Grid Row Markers Demo
items.description: rowMarkers modes (none/number/checkbox/both): a pinned-left marker column outside the data index space, switchable at runtime.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-custom-headers-demo
items.title: Data Grid Custom Headers Demo
items.description: Column header as a React component: a three-state sort icon (minus / up / down) driven by useDataGridSortState(); header click sorts in sort mode, and a custom header owns its display.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-custom-markers-demo
items.title: Data Grid Custom Markers Demo
items.description: Custom row marker renderers (renderMarker/renderMarkerHeader): a lucide icon marker reflecting the row selection state, and a select-all header button, while the marker cell's own press/drag gestures still select rows.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-pinning-all-sides-demo
items.title: Data Grid Pinning All Sides Demo
items.description: All four pin zones at once: Name pinned left, Logins pinned right, plus an averages row pinned to the top band and a totals row pinned to the bottom band via the data-grid-pinned-rows add-on, over 200 rows so both directions scroll.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-pinning-demo
items.title: Data Grid Pinning Demo
items.description: Column pinning (left/right), resize (incl. a resizable:false column and a flex:1 long-content column for double-click autosize), and drag-to-reorder, with the header dropdown menu for pin/unpin/autosize and a toolbar columns menu for show/hide.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-column-drag-demo
items.title: Data Grid Column Drag Demo
items.description: Drag a header to reorder columns within its pin zone (enableColumnReorder, per-column reorderable opt-out, pinned-right column), plus a column picker wired to the programmatic setColumnOrder(id, targetId, position) path.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-column-groups-demo
items.title: Data Grid Column Groups Demo
items.description: Column groups: Contact, Work with a nested History group, and Activity sit above their columns. Click a group header to select its columns, drag a group header to move the block, and use the columns menu to hide members.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-column-layout-demo
items.title: Data Grid Column Layout Demo
items.description: Column layout persistence: defaultColumnLayout seeds widths/order/pins/hidden from a localStorage snapshot at mount, onColumnLayoutChange writes every resize commit, reorder, pin, and hide back; a Reset button clears the snapshot and re-seeds.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-actions-demo
items.title: Data Grid Actions Demo
items.description: Action-buttons column pattern: a pinned-right readOnly column whose renderCell composes shadcn Buttons over store actions (startEditing on the row's first editable cell, deleteRows/duplicateRows by view index) plus a more dropdown (Edit, Duplicate, Delete).
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-row-ops-demo
items.title: Data Grid Row Ops Demo
items.description: Row operations from two surfaces: toolbar buttons (insert above/below, duplicate, delete on the current selection) and the right-click context menu, with a side panel showing the last onDataChange payload (source + id-keyed ops) and a read-only toggle.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-large-data-demo
items.title: Data Grid Large Data Demo
items.description: 100k generated rows proving row virtualization: only the virtualized rows around the viewport ever mount.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-performance-demo
items.title: Data Grid Performance Demo
items.description: 100k generated rows with a top-left FPS meter overlay so the scroll-performance claim is checkable live.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-pinned-rows-demo
items.title: Data Grid Pinned Rows Demo
items.description: Totals and averages rows pinned under the header, recomputed live from the grid's data on every edit, and filter-aware via a toolbar filter menu on the Role column.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-server-totals-demo
items.title: Data Grid Server Totals Demo
items.description: A scrolling grid over a fake server whose totals row is computed by the server for the whole filtered result, with loading and stale states.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-lookup-demo
items.title: Data Grid Lookup Demo
items.description: A customer column that searches a fake server as you type and stores the picked key with its label.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-conditional-styling-demo
items.title: Data Grid Conditional Styling Demo
items.description: An HR dataset showing all four value-driven styling surfaces: grid-level getRowClassName/getCellClassName plus per-column cellClassName/headerClassName, all using shadcn theme tokens.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-styling-patterns-demo
items.title: Data Grid Styling Patterns Demo
items.description: A fully-styled brand column (per-column cellClassName/headerClassName), a fully-styled at-risk row (getRowClassName beyond a bg tint), and a live density/rowHeight toggle.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-server-filter-demo
items.title: Data Grid Server Filter Demo
items.description: A lazy grid filtered by a fake server: filterMode="server" keeps the rows as fetched, and the header filter lists the server's values through fetchFilterValues.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-lazy-demo
items.title: Data Grid Lazy Demo
items.description: 100k rows, only a handful loaded up front; a simulated-latency in-memory API fetches each scrolled-into window on demand, with skeleton rows filling in as data lands.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-open-ended-demo
items.title: Data Grid Open-Ended Demo
items.description: A server that sends a cursor and no row count: infinite scroll and a pager over a keyset API, both through useDataGridServerRows.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-server-selection-demo
items.title: Data Grid Server Selection Demo
items.description: Checked rows that survive page changes and select all matching over a paged result: totalRowCount, actions.selectAllMatching, and useDataGridSelectedRows.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-write-ack-demo
items.title: Data Grid Save Acknowledgement Demo
items.description: onDataChange returns a promise: rows show saving while it is pending, a refused cell reverts on its own, and onSaveRejected reports the server's message.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-save-conflict-demo
items.title: Data Grid Save Conflict Demo
items.description: A mock server refuses a save with its current row, and resolveSaveConflict returns theirs, mine, or a merged row; the log shows what each row becomes.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-id-swap-demo
items.title: Data Grid Id Swap Demo
items.description: A new row starts with a client id; the mock server answers with its own id, and actions.replaceRowId swaps it in with one onDataChange of source id-swap.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-row-action-results-demo
items.title: Data Grid Row Action Results Demo
items.description: A slow onBeforeDeleteRows gate under gateTimeoutMs: the log shows each RowActionResult, every onRowActionSkipped reason, and the aborted gate.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-pagination-demo
items.title: Data Grid Pagination Demo
items.description: Client-mode pagination: useDataGridPagination slices a generated dataset and <DataGridPaginationBar /> renders the default footer (first/prev/pages/next/last, page-size select, range label).
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-sort-list-demo
items.title: Data Grid Sort List Demo
items.description: Toolbar sort button + popover: add/remove sorts, toggle ascending/descending, and reorder precedence via drag handle or ArrowUp/ArrowDown keyboard.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-header-filter-demo
items.title: Data Grid Header Filter Demo
items.description: Header filter button on each column: search the distinct values, check the ones to keep, and apply.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-find-replace-demo
items.title: Data Grid Find and Replace Demo
items.description: Open the find-and-replace panel with Ctrl+H, replace one match or all of them, and undo the whole replace in one step.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-announcements-demo
items.title: Data Grid Announcements Demo
items.description: The live region announces checked rows and, with announceResults, the result count; a line on the page mirrors the spoken text.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-checked-rows-demo
items.title: Data Grid Checked Rows Demo
items.description: Checked rows survive a filter with checkedRowsLifetime 'across-filters'; the status bar counts the hidden checked rows.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-delete-confirm-demo
items.title: Data Grid Delete Confirm Demo
items.description: onBeforeDeleteRows returns a promise from a confirm dialog; Cancel keeps the checked rows and Delete removes them.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-touch-demo
items.title: Data Grid Touch Demo
items.description: Touch gestures: tap selects, double-tap edits, selection handles extend the range, and a long press opens the context menu with Fill down and Fill right.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-status-bar-demo
items.title: Data Grid Status Bar Demo
items.description: Select a range, a row, or a column — the status bar below the grid aggregates count, sum, avg, min, and max of the selection in real time.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-detail-panel-demo
items.title: Data Grid Detail Panel Demo
items.description: Show the active row in a non-modal side panel opened from onCellClick or a custom Ctrl+Shift+Enter command.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-comments
items.title: Data Grid Comments
items.description: Cell comments add-on for the gridcn data grid: useDataGridComments adds comments addressed by row id and column id, a corner marker, a comments popover with keyboard access (Shift+F2), optimistic versioned saves through onCommentSave, echo matching for applyRemote, and fetchComments for the rendered rows.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-comments-demo
items.title: Data Grid Comments Demo
items.description: Cell comments on a client-only grid: no user and no server. Anonymous comments are saved in the browser's local storage.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-comments-server-demo
items.title: Data Grid Comments Server Demo
items.description: Cell comments with a simulated second user over an in-memory compare-and-swap server: add, edit, resolve, and delete comments, take the connection offline, and force a stale conflict.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-presence-demo
items.title: Data Grid Presence Demo
items.description: 3 simulated users move cell/range selections on a timer via useDataGridPresence's setPresenceHighlights (2 in view-space range form, 1 rowId-native), with toolbar avatar chips, one user periodically overlapping another, and headerClickBehavior="sort" proving the rowId-native highlight follows its row through a sort.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-events-demo
items.title: Data Grid Events Demo
items.description: Grid with a live inspector panel pretty-printing the latest payload per event: onDataChange, onSelectionChange, onSortChange, onFilterChange/join, onFill, onRenderedRowsChange, onColumnLayoutChange, and a presence read-back button.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-validation-demo
items.title: Data Grid Validation Demo
items.description: Nine rejection paths in one grid: a sync function (Age), hand-rolled sync/async/coercing Standard Schemas (Email, SKU, Price), a soft validationMode rule (Notes), and one column per major library that implements Standard Schema natively — Zod (Score), Joi (Code), Valibot (Tag). Pasting mixed valid/invalid values shows the bulk-rejection path.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-async-gates-demo
items.title: Data Grid Async Gates Demo
items.description: Async gates against a simulated server: processPaste normalizes a paste, validateRow checks a SKU after the edit commits, and createRow waits for a server-assigned id. A promise holds the gesture and the grid writes once when it settles.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-cross-field-demo
items.title: Data Grid Cross Field Demo
items.description: Cross-field validation with validateRow: an End time must stay at or after its Start. The row is judged after a whole write gesture commits; a rejected row flags the named cell like a server error (the value still commits, no rollback) and the flag clears once the row is consistent again.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-cell-errors-demo
items.title: Data Grid Cell Errors Demo
items.description: A fake saveOrders rejects any committed Quantity over 100 after ~600ms; the onSave handler calls actions.setCellErrors to paint the exact cell with the same ring/tint/aria-invalid treatment as a live validate rejection, after commit. A badge reads the count via useDataGridCellErrors(), and a Clear all button calls clearCellErrors().
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-linked-grids-demo
items.title: Data Grid Linked Grids Demo
items.description: Two grids linked through React state: onActiveCellChange of a customer grid sets the rows of a read-only order grid.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-i18n-demo
items.title: Data Grid I18n Demo
items.description: A locale Select (English/Deutsch/Arabic) where each locale carries its strings and its text direction: labels, column headers, and hint text translate via deep-merged overrides, and the Arabic locale flips the grid to RTL through the direction prop.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-clipboard-demo
items.title: Data Grid Clipboard Demo
items.description: A grid with formula-like text cells and sanitizeClipboardFormulas: copy a range and paste it into a spreadsheet to get the formulas as text.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-fill-patterns-demo
items.title: Data Grid Fill Patterns Demo
items.description: A staged dataset with a numeric series (1,2,3), a zero-padded series (001,002), a text-plus-number series (Item 1,2,3), and a plain-text column — dragging the fill handle down each shows series extrapolation vs. plain tiling; Alt/Option forces a copy and Ctrl/Cmd+D/R do the same from the keyboard.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-loading-demo
items.title: Data Grid Loading Demo
items.description: Two Switches (loading, rows present) reach all three states of the loading prop: zero rows + loading = viewport-filling skeleton, rows present + loading = a slim indeterminate bar under the header, zero rows + not loading = the ordinary empty state.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-playground-demo
items.title: Data Grid Playground Demo
items.description: Every add-on composed in one grid: toolbar, context menu, fill, undo/redo, keybindings, sort list, import/export, plus independent toggles (row markers, pinned totals, validation, read-only, loading, RTL, presence, streaming, density, header click) and an exclusive virtualized/paginated/lazy mode select.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-lazy-react-query-demo
items.title: Data Grid Lazy React Query Demo
items.description: 10k rows fetched through a TanStack Query cache: each scrolled window becomes a fetchQuery (deduped, cached for the session, scrolling back never refetches).
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-cursor-react-query-demo
items.title: Data Grid Cursor React Query Demo
items.description: A cursor source without a row count through useInfiniteQuery: infinite scroll and a pager that follows the cursor chain.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-cursor-swr-demo
items.title: Data Grid Cursor SWR Demo
items.description: A cursor source without a row count through useSWRInfinite: infinite scroll and a pager that follows the cursor chain.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-lazy-swr-demo
items.title: Data Grid Lazy SWR Demo
items.description: 10k rows fetched through SWR's global cache via preload: each scrolled window is fetched once per key and shared with any useSWR consumer.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-pagination-react-query-demo
items.title: Data Grid Pagination React Query Demo
items.description: Server-mode pagination backed by useQuery: the current page/pageSize is the query key, edits write through to the fake server then invalidate the cached pages.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-pagination-swr-demo
items.title: Data Grid Pagination SWR Demo
items.description: Server-mode pagination backed by useSWR: the page is cached by key so paging back is instant, and edits revalidate the current key after writing through.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-server-side-demo
items.title: Data Grid Server Side Demo
items.description: The full remote contract in about fifteen lines of wiring: useDataGridServerRows owns sort, filter, search and page (or scroll blocks); every change is sent to the fake server, a stale request is aborted, and edits save through onSave and refetch.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-pointer-demo
items.title: Data Grid Pointer Demo
items.description: Mouse selection with a switch for headerClickBehavior: select, sort, or none.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-density-demo
items.title: Data Grid Density Demo
items.description: The compact, default, and comfortable density presets on one grid.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-keyboard-demo
items.title: Data Grid Keyboard Demo
items.description: Move, extend, and edit with the keyboard while a line shows the last chord.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-toolbar-demo
items.title: Data Grid Toolbar Demo
items.description: Search, filter menu, sort list, and columns menu in toolbar order.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-quick-search-demo
items.title: Data Grid Quick Search Demo
items.description: Quick search seeded with defaultSearchText: highlights, a match counter, and no hidden rows.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-colors-radius-demo
items.title: Data Grid Colors Radius Demo
items.description: A preset switcher: radius 0, 0.625rem, and 1rem, a tinted primary, and dark mode.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-global-shortcuts-demo
items.title: Data Grid Global Shortcuts Demo
items.description: Undo and redo keep working while focus sits on a custom toolbar - the opt-in useDataGridGlobalShortcuts hook, with the editable-target guard shown live.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-row-reorder-demo
items.title: Data Grid Row Reorder Demo
items.description: Drag rows by the reorder grip or move the active row with reorderRows - both emit one id-keyed move op (a single undo step), and row selection remaps by row id.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-server-query
items.title: Data Grid Server Query
items.description: The server half of a server-driven gridcn grid: a column map that is the allow-list and the projection, parseQuery that turns an untrusted grid request into a bounded, typed query plan (escaping, null and blank rules, number and day bounds, limits), handleGridRequest for a route handler, and describeFilterOperators so the filter UI offers only what the server accepts. Add an ORM adapter to run the plan.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-server-query-drizzle
items.title: Data Grid Server Query Drizzle
items.description: Runs the grid's sort, filter tree, quick search, offset or cursor paging, row count, set values, aggregates, groups, and pivots with Drizzle on PostgreSQL and SQLite: columnsFromDrizzleTable builds the column map from a schema, createDrizzleGridQuery returns fetchRows for useDataGridServerRows.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-server-query-kysely
items.title: Data Grid Server Query Kysely
items.description: Runs the grid's sort, filter tree, quick search, offset or cursor paging, row count, set values, aggregates, groups, and pivots with Kysely on PostgreSQL and SQLite: createKyselyGridQuery returns fetchRows for useDataGridServerRows.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-server-query-prisma
items.title: Data Grid Server Query Prisma
items.description: Runs the grid's sort, filter tree, quick search, offset or cursor paging, row count, set values, aggregates, groups, and pivots with the Prisma Client object API on PostgreSQL and SQLite: definePrismaColumnMap builds the column map, typed by a generated model, and createPrismaGridQuery returns fetchRows for useDataGridServerRows.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-server-query-supabase
items.title: Data Grid Server Query Supabase
items.description: Runs the grid's sort, filter tree, quick search, offset or cursor paging, and row count through the caller's Supabase client over PostgREST: createSupabaseGridQuery returns fetchRows for useDataGridServerRows. grid-query.sql defines the grid function that answers set values, aggregates, groups, and pivots.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-server-query-demo
items.title: Data Grid Server Query Demo
items.description: A scrolling grid over an in-browser PostgreSQL (PGlite) served by the query layer and Drizzle: the filter tree, quick search, sort, row count, and set values run as SQL, a panel shows the last statements with their bound parameters, and a switch adds a hostile filter value.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-row-grouping-demo
items.title: Data Grid Row Grouping Demo
items.description: Car sales grouped by region and then by dealership, with a count, an average discount, and the revenue on each group row, buttons to open, close, and regroup, and Group by items in the header menu.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-pivot-demo
items.title: Data Grid Pivot Demo
items.description: 5,000 car sales pivoted on the client: one row per region, one column per make, and the revenue in each cell, with buttons that switch the pivot column to financed or turn the pivot off.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-server-grouping-demo
items.title: Data Grid Server Grouping Demo
items.description: A scrolling grid grouped on an in-browser PostgreSQL (PGlite): the query layer answers each group list with one statement, and a panel shows the last statement with its bound parameters.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-server-pivot-demo
items.title: Data Grid Server Pivot Demo
items.description: A server pivot on an in-browser PostgreSQL (PGlite): one row per region, one generated column per make, and the revenue in each cell. A panel shows the last statement with its bound parameters.
items.author: gridcn
